name: BooBoo Buddy
tagline: Triages symptoms, flags emergencies, calls nearby clinics for openings and books the slot you pick.

awards: Dialogue - Sponsor Challenge // Dialogue - Défi commandité

problem: Sick people must make call after call to find a clinic that can see them.
solution: Conversational triage that escalates emergencies to 911, finds clinics with Places data, calls them through Twilio to check availability, then books with a confirmation call.
demo_moment: Team-described: chat about symptoms, watch the clinic calls, choose a time.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Dialogue - Sponsor Challenge // Dialogue - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Includes a page disclosing its generative-AI use.

lessons: Know when not to help: an emergency check builds trust in the rest.
